title: SmolVM: a single-executable VM that cold-starts in under a second, real hardware isolation

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Docker solves it works on my machine. Small VM takes a different approach. Just ship the entire machine. It packs your software into a single executable small machine file that codes in under a second using hypervisor framework on Mac OS or KVM on Linux via libcrun. Real hardware isolation, not container namespaces. Built by a former AWS firecracker engineer. Live migration on the road
